verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documentation of Drata sending control-failure or drift alerts to Slack, email, or ticketing tools, nor of what context such alerts would carry. The closest item (drata-docs-3) is a generic line about workflows with "custom triggers and actions" for monitoring controls. It names no alert destinations or alert content, so it does not establish the capability. The status-page email item (drata-docs-37) covers Drata's own service incidents, not customer control failures, so it is off-topic.

support.subject: As an IT admin, control failures and configuration drift alert me where I work — Slack, email, or ticketing — with enough context to fix the finding
